rules.statement: State the safety measures taken under PIPA 29 and Decree 30 and 30-2.
Describe the managerial, technical and physical measures actually implemented (per the safety-measures standard), not a generic list.
Where disclosure could raise breach risk, the level of detail may be reduced without affecting security.

physical: access control to server and records rooms
locked storage of documents and removable media

goodPatterns: Three numbered lines: managerial, technical, physical; each lists only measures confirmed in the interview.

commonDefects.defect: Boilerplate list includes measures the company does not perform (accuracy defect).
Only technical measures listed; managerial and physical missing.

extractionHints: encryption, access control, logs, firewall, VPN, training
